segments.line: You open the case. You
unfold four little arms. You
press one button, and
it screams up into the sky.
Below you, two thousand workers drop their ropes at the same time. A
camel bolts. An
old man falls to his knees.
On your screen you can see all of it from above. A
giant pyramid, only half finished, and
thousands of tiny people staring straight up at you.
A soldier throws a spear at it.
Miss.
Another one. Miss.
Somebody shouts a word you don't understand.
Then everyone is shouting it.
This is Egypt, about four and a half thousand years ago.
Nobody here has ever seen anything fly that isn't a bird or a bug.
And you just brought a camera drone.
Battery: ninety- one percent.
So what would actually happen if you brought a drone to
ancient Egypt?
